September 2026 • Our first honoree

Our First Good Gardener

A good heart. A good attitude. A great smile.

Our first Good Gardener of the Month is someone who always tries his best and cares about doing a really good job. He brings effort, strength, and a good heart to what he does. That is a good place to start.

Someone you can depend on

Being dependable matters. It means people can count on you to show up, put in the effort, and take the job seriously. Our first honoree takes pride in doing his best and being strong for the people who need him.

A good heart, put into action

He helps people out. When someone needs something, he helps them get it. That kind of practical care makes a difference: noticing a need and doing something about it.

The attitude he brings

He brings a good attitude along with the hard work. He wants to do well and help the people around him. And he has a great smile—the kind that deserves a place right here on the homepage.

Why he is a Good Gardener

Good Gardener honors people who bring care and dedication to what they do. Our first honoree does that by trying his best, doing a really good job, being dependable and strong, and helping people get what they need.

For his effort, his good heart, his good attitude, and that great smile, we are proud to recognize our very first Good Gardener of the Month.
